gerados.Text: A healthy, well-fed adult sits at {{c1::zero}} nitrogen balance.
gerados.Extra: N in − N out; ~90% urinary urea. Positive: growth, pregnancy, healing. Negative: fasting, trauma, infection.

gerados.Text: Free ammonia is released from glutamate by {{c1::glutamate dehydrogenase}}, regenerating α-ketoglutarate.
gerados.Extra: Truly removes N (transamination only transferred it to glutamate). Mitochondrial, hepatic. NAD+/NADP+.
